title: SealyMod
description: A useful mod that adds a few features, such as a HUD.
body:
This is a useful mod that I made to add some features and tweak a few things in Minecraft.

## Current Features:
**1. Customizable HUD Overlay**

A dynamic HUD engine that can be fully customized directly inside the configuration screens.
Users can create multiple "widgets" that each can display dynamic text, such as, for example, the fps using "My fps is: ${client.fps()}". They can also be dynamically positioned, such as in the middle of the screen, using x: "screenwidth/2" and y: "screenheight/2".

**2. Fire Renderer Tweak**

An optional rendering feature that adjusts and squares out the layout, width, height, and exponential scaling of the fire overlay on entities.

**All features are disabled by default. They can be enabled in the config.**
